summary.ru: Дал Риада — раннесредневековое гэльское королевство, охватывавшее западное побережье Шотландии и север Ирландии. Главным поселением, судя по всему, был Дунадд.
summary.en: Dál Riata or Dál Riada was a Gaelic kingdom that encompassed the western seaboard of Scotland and northeastern Ireland, on each side of the North Channel. At its height in the 6th and 7th centuries, it covered what is now Argyll in Scotland and part of County Antrim in Northern Ireland. After a period of expansion, Dál Riata eventually became associated with the Gaelic Kingdom of Alba.
